7084-7885-8250.easyPrerequisites:
Down in the Valley's second chapter ability has resolved.
You control a land.
7084-7885-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4289-4770-6090-7297.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2023-3755-4770-6965.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

803-4050-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
803-4050-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat from step 3.

3174-4247-5571--6.description:
Use Switcheroo to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-1987-3075.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1018-1987-3075.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-3075.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-3043-4068.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-4068.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

206-1368-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
206-1368-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2232-2792-4541-5705.manaNeeded: {1} if you control fewer than eight Treasures
2232-2792-4541-5705.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}
2232-2792-4541-5705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven Treasures.
2232-2792-4541-5705.description:
Activate at least seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {7}.
Cast Marut by paying at least {7} gained from Treasures, plus an extra up to {1} if needed.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Cloudstone Curio and Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve Marut. When Marut enters, it triggers, creating a Treasure for each mana from a Treasure spent to cast it.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}
Cast Great Whale by paying its mana cost.
When Great Whale enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
2232-2792-4541-5705.notes: If you control eight or more Treasures, use eight Treasures to cast Marut, which foregoes step 12.

1170-2440-4758-7499.description:
Cast the copy of Pest Friend from exile by paying {B/G}.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
When Lluwen, Exchange Student enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} each time for each Pest you control.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat.

4556-5256-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
4556-5256-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Blight Mound and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blight Mound trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1417-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
1417-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Bridge from Below and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-2097-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve the The Third Doctor trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with "You don't lose the game due to having 0 or less life"

2656-7074--84.description:
Activate Koh by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Resolve all Koh abilities.
Cast Repay in Kind by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each opponent's life total to become 0.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having 0 life.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

104-3490-4050-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4050-4268.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

997-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

1456-3518-4195-4574.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

413-856-5477-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar, Blasting Station and Insidious Roots trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
When the Plant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4068-4094.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1563-2457-4068-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2334-2724-3080-4608.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
2334-2724-3080-4608.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

4885-5470-6188.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
4885-5470-6188.description:
Create a token copy of Fear of Missing Out.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Fear of Missing Out token.
When the Fear of Missing Out token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to rummage.
Move to your combat phase and declare the Fear of Missing Out token as an attacker.
The Fear of Missing Out token triggers, untapping Ghired and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

2896-5145-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

813-1987-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-997-3645.description:
Cast Black Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{B}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Black Sun's Twilight.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Black Sun's Twilight
Resolve the Black Sun's Twilight copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

141-997-5748.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one historic permanent card in your graveyard.
141-997-5748.description:
Cast What Must Be Done by paying {3}{W}{W}, targeting any historic permanent card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting What Must Be Done.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying What Must Be Done, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of What Must Be Done, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat from step 3.

439-2438-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.
439-2438-4766-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1283-2825-3298-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Elite Arcanist.
Elite Arcanist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two Goblins.
1283-2825-3298-4222.description:
Activate Elite Arcanist's ability by paying {1} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brightstone Ritual without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brightstone Ritual, adding at least {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Elite Arcanist.
Repeat.
If you control three of more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

1636-3799-3828.notablePrerequisites:
Druid's Call attached to Stuffy Doll.
Stuffy Doll does not have summoning sickness.
1636-3799-3828.description:
Activate Stuffy Doll by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Stuffy Doll and Druid's Call trigger.
Resolve the Stuffy Doll trigger, dealing 1 damage to the chosen player.
Resolve the Druid's Call trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

224-539-962-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature that has haste.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
224-539-962-4499.description:
Activate the nontoken creature with haste by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking the nontoken creature with haste.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next step and/or phase, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to the amount of unspent mana they have.

2732-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature token.
2732-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {1}.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

872-959-1637-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Islands.
872-959-1637-4423.description:
Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting Mystic Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, triggering itself and Aesi.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, returning Tidal Bore from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Resolve the Aesi trigger, causing you to draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1283-3586-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Magus Lucea Kane.
Magus Lucea Kane does not have summoning sickness.
1283-3586-4222.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {1}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
You may then cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its mana cost, getting infinite copies of that spell or ability.

2564-4125-4231-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser.
Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Lonis.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Lonis trigger, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1842-2684-2724.notablePrerequisites: Sunscape Apprentice does not have summoning sickness.
1842-2684-2724.description:
Tap Sunscape Apprentice for {U} to put Wormfang Manta on top of your library.
Wormfang Manta's LTB triggers, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Activate Mastery of the Unseen for {3}{W} to manifest Wormfang Manta.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn it face up.
Repeat for infinite turns.
